serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `graphql-lsp` executable. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of the GraphQL server the editor uses. Turning one off hands it to the next server serving the same file.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report GraphQL syntax and schema validation errors in the linter.

autocomplete.title: Autocomplete
autocomplete.description: Offer schema fields, arguments, types, directives and variables.

hover.title: Hover
hover.description: Show schema documentation and type information on hover.

definition.title: Go To Definition
definition.description: Jump to schema types, fields and fragment definitions.

symbols.title: Symbols
symbols.description: Serve document and workspace GraphQL symbols to go-to-symbol.

outline.title: Outline
outline.description: Fill the outline panel with operations, fragments and schema definitions.

config.title: GraphQL Config
config.description: How the server discovers the project's GraphQL schema and documents.

filePath.title: Config File
filePath.description: Exact GraphQL config file path. Leave empty to discover one from the project root.

configName.title: Config Name
configName.description: Configuration filename prefix used during discovery.

legacy.title: Legacy Config
legacy.description: Also discover configuration formats used by graphql-config 2.

dotEnvPath.title: Environment File
dotEnvPath.description: Path to a dotenv file loaded before resolving schema pointers. Leave empty to skip it.

languageService.title: Language Service
languageService.description: Schema cache and logging behavior used by the GraphQL server.

cacheSchemaFileForLookup.title: Schema Lookup Cache
cacheSchemaFileForLookup.description: Cache a generated SDL schema for navigation, decide automatically, or disable the cache.

schemaCacheTTL.title: Schema Cache Lifetime
schemaCacheTTL.description: Minimum schema cache lifetime in milliseconds.

debug.title: Debug Logging
debug.description: Write verbose GraphQL server output to the language-server log.
